transcript.content: Hello, I'm glad you're here today. What brings you in to see me?

I'm here because I've been struggling with constant, uncontrollable worry and anxiety almost every single day. It has been going on for about a year and seven months now, and it's just become too difficult for me to manage on my own.

Are these worries mostly about everyday things like health, family, or work, or do you experience repetitive, unwanted thoughts that make you feel like you have to perform certain actions or rituals to calm down?

Yes, my worries are mostly about everyday things like my work, family, finances, and school. I don't experience any repetitive thoughts that force me to perform specific actions or rituals to calm myself down.
Alongside this anxiety, have you also been experiencing a persistently low, down, or depressed mood, or a loss of interest or pleasure in the things you normally enjoy?
No, I haven't really been feeling depressed or losing interest in my hobbies. The main issue for me is just this constant, overwhelming worry and anxiety that never seems to stop.
When you're feeling this anxious, do you also experience physical symptoms like muscle tension, trouble sleeping, restlessness, or feeling easily fatigued?
I'm not really sure if I've had those physical symptoms, as I haven't noticed much of that. For me, the struggle is almost entirely in my head with the constant, non-stop worrying.
Do you find that this constant worrying makes it hard for you to concentrate on things, or have you been feeling more irritable and easily annoyed lately?

Yes, my worries constantly pop into my head out of nowhere, making it really hard to focus or concentrate on my daily tasks. However, I haven't really noticed feeling particularly irritable or easily annoyed lately.

No, I don't really feel restless or "keyed up" like that. My anxiety is mostly just the constant, overwhelming worrying going on in my head.
How has your sleep been lately? Do you find it difficult to fall asleep or stay asleep because of the constant worrying?
I haven't really noticed any major issues with my sleep, so I'm not entirely sure about that. My main struggle is just the constant, overwhelming worrying that occupies my mind throughout the day.
Sometimes constant worry can cause physical tension without us fully realizing it. Have you noticed any tightness, stiffness, or soreness in your muscles, like in your neck, shoulders, or back?

To be honest, I haven't really noticed or thought about any physical muscle tension, stiffness, or soreness in my neck, shoulders, or back. My body feels okay, it's really just my mind that feels completely overwhelmed by all the worry.
Did your anxiety and worry start after a specific stressful life event or major change about a year and a half ago, or did it seem to develop gradually on its own?

I have been dealing with this anxiety for about a year and seven months now. However, I'm not really sure if it was triggered by a specific event or if it just developed gradually on its own. It just seems to have slowly taken over my mind over time.
